QuestInfo.name: Jewel Thieves
QuestInfo.0: Report the suspicious rabbit to the Dark Lord!
QuestInfo.1: You report the intruder but are unable to confirm the jewel's location. \r\nGo tell Olive, who's waiting outside.
QuestInfo.2: You report the intruder but are unable to confirm the jewel's location. \r\nOlive tells you about a similar jewel that was stolen from under her nose in the past. She thinks the rabbit and other thief might be part of the same organization.
QuestInfo.demandSummary: Speak with Olive in front of the Jazz bar.

0.0: Is the jewel safe? \r\n#L0##bThe jewel is fine, but the intruder got away.#l\n#k
0.1: Sigh. I was just about to ask Athena Pierce about the jewel's powers. I didn't expect someone to infiltrate my home. I suppose information on the jewel got leaked. My apologies for not trusting you earlier.

yes.0: You have my thanks for protecting the jewel. Had it been stolen, I can't even imagine what would've happened.

no.0: Don't be petty. That's all the apology you'll get.

1.0: Too bad you couldn't locate the jewel, pal. \r\nDid I mention that I'm lookin' out for special jewels with unique powers?
1.1: But every time I get a lead, the jewel gets stolen before I can get there! I had my hopes set on this one...
1.2: I'd bet my left boot that the intruder you scared off is part of a bigger organization. How else would he have been able to infiltrate a master thief's hideout?

yes.0: It's a shame I didn't get the info I was lookin' for, but at least the jewel's safe.
yes.1: Guess I'll keep diggin' around for info on other jewels. I'll get you that coffee I promised next time, pal.

npc.0: This could've been a catastrophe. I'll have to question all my men...
